sn35.9:1.3: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ cakkhusmiṃ anapekho hoti.
sn35.9:1.5: paccuppannassa cakkhussa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
sn35.9:1.6: sotaṃ anattā atītānāgataṃ. ko pana vādo paccuppannassa …pe…
sn35.9:1.7: ghānaṃ anattā atītānāgataṃ. ko pana vādo paccuppannassa …pe…
sn35.9:1.16: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako atītasmiṃ manasmiṃ anapekho hoti,
sn35.9:1.18: paccuppannassa manassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hotīti.
